instruction: Set Chrome's fixed-width font size to 14px to improve code readability.

metadata.explanation: Task asks user to set Chrome's fixed-width (monospace) font size to 14 pixels. The evaluator reads the webkit.webprefs.default_fixed_font_size setting from Chrome's Preferences file and checks if it equals 14. This setting affects how monospace text (like code snippets) is displayed in the browser.
